cover.report_type: Amendment (no Type-of-Report box checked); hand-written header 'September 2008 2nd Amendment'

_meta.notes: 2012-vintage blank hand-titled 'September 2008 2nd Amendment' on the cover and 'September 2008' on the Summary Page, signed and filed 2/14/13. NO Type-of-Report box is checked; only the amendment 'Yes' box with date of report 2/14/13. Line 2 Column B writes the cents crammed at the cell edge ('140,509' then '65'), read at 300 dpi as 140,509.65. Line 7 is written '5760.35' without a thousands comma - recorded as seen. Line 3 chains from the June amendment's line 7. Arithmetic checks: 18,503.86 + 42,100 = 60,603.86 and 60,603.86 - 54,843.51 = 5,760.35.

itemized.itemized_pages_B: 4-5 (portrait spreadsheet titled 'Schedule B / Itemized Expenditures Made'; the table breaks across the two pages)

contributions.detail: exact (42,100 = 42,100). 22 lines sum to 42100, equal to the attachment's own printed total 42100 (the figure sitting one row below the last amount) and to Summary Page line 1 Column A. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: on this sheet the Amount column is physically separated from the name block by a wide blank gap, so alignment was verified independently - the four rows marked 'In Kind' (RC Automotive 3000, Tres Hombres 6000, Warren 1000, R&R Partners 3500) match, party-for-party and figure-for-figure, the four 'in kind' lines on Schedule B. That is a four-point cross-table check that no shift occurred.

expenditures.detail: delta -0.30 (rows sum 54,843.81 vs stated 54,843.51). CAUSE IDENTIFIED ON THE PAGE: the p5 Total cell is printed '54843.81' with the last figure struck and '51' written beside it BY HAND. The 66 itemized lines sum to 54,843.81 - i.e. they gate EXACTLY against the spreadsheet's own TYPED total - and the hand-written correction to 54,843.51 is what was carried onto the Summary Page. So the 0.30 is a manual edit of the total that was never pushed back into any line. The two single-decimal amounts (82.8 and 587.4) were re-read at 1000 dpi and are correct, so the 0.30 is not a mis-read cents group. Both figures retained verbatim; no row adjusted.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: This filer's spreadsheets print no per-page SUBTOTAL, only one grand total per schedule. Schedule A (p3): 22 rows 42,100 = printed total 42100 - GATE PASSES. Schedule B (p4-p5): 66 rows 54,843.81 = the p5 Total cell's TYPED figure 54843.81 - GATE PASSES against the typed total, but NOT against the hand-corrected 54843.51 that reached the Summary Page. Both figures named. Had p5 not been rendered the expenditures side would have been short 14 rows and $22,269.94.
itemized.escalation_note: p3 is a LANDSCAPE spreadsheet: a two-up probe render (both rotation signs, reduced) established rotate(+90) CCW for this file, then p3 was re-rendered at 250 dpi, rotated CCW and cropped tight. p4/p5 are portrait and were read at 260 dpi in three tight bands (p4 rows 1-3, rows 1-28, rows 28-52; p5 all). Three 1000 dpi tight cell crops: the p5 Total cell (which revealed the struck typed figure and the handwritten '51'), and the p4 amounts 82.8 and 587.4 (to rule them out as the source of the 0.30 gap). Row bands from the tables' own printed rules on p4/p5 and from a projection profile on the rotated p3.
itemized.notes: Randy Horiuchi, Office Sought 'Council at Large A', Democrat. TYPE OF REPORT: no period box is checked at all - only 'Is this report an amendment? YES, date of report 2/14/13' - and a HAND-WRITTEN header on pages 1 and 2 reads 'September 2008 / 2nd Amendment'. The attachments date themselves 'Sept. 15/08'. Note the form's printed interim-period labels are the 2012 ones (April 5 / June 19 / September 15 / October 30, 2012) even though this is a 2008 report on a 2012 form blank, and the signature is dated 2/14/13 - a 2013 signature on a September-2008 period. All of this is recorded, not resolved. County redaction bars cover the cover's street-address row and the phone/fax/email cells. Schedule A carries NO address column at all, so no donor geography exists. FOUR MATCHED IN-KIND PAIRS appear on both schedules (RC Automotive 3000 campaign vehicle, Tres Hombres 6000 outdoor advertising, Warren 1000 volunteer event, R&R Partners 3500 graphic design) - these also served as the field-shift check on the contributions sheet. The candidate's own relative Wayne Horiuchi gave 500. Expenditures side misses the Summary figure by 0.30 because of a HAND-CORRECTED total on p5; the lines themselves gate exactly against the typed total.
